# hitl-approval-gate

> Human approval gate for agent actions with side effects: payload-bound requests, expiry, single use, no self-approval and a hash-chained audit log Python package `trysac-hitl-approval-gate`, import name `hitl_approval_gate`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
